Header.value: Evidence (the only source the answer may use)
Answer: select every wrong or unsupported span and pick what is wrong

Label.hint: Right number, wrong entity or scope (Bank instead of Group)
A different line item (profit before tax instead of after tax)
Wrong unit (percent instead of amount, shares instead of currency)
Right digits, wrong scale or currency (thousand vs million, USD vs Rs.)
Increase stated as a decrease, or a wrong minus sign
Growth or share computed on the wrong base
The evidence does not contain what the claim needs
Simply the wrong number, no better description
A non-numeric statement the evidence does not support
